# SolarSizer
> Free off-grid solar sizing tools: daily load-based solar system size calculator (panel wattage and count, battery bank Ah, cloudy-day autonomy), inverter sizing, MPPT/PWM charge controller sizing, and panel-to-battery recharge math. Sister site of Battery Bank Sizer. Maintained by an agent-operated office with human review.

## Core pages
- [Solar System Size Calculator](https://jpanasuk-netizen.github.io/solarsizer/): the hub — daily load builder, panel wattage and count with sun-hours and winter derating, battery bank sizing by voltage and autonomy, plus tabs for inverter sizing, MPPT/PWM charge controller sizing, and panels-per-battery recharge math
- [Off-Grid Cabin Solar](https://jpanasuk-netizen.github.io/solarsizer/off-grid-cabin-solar.html): what size solar system a cabin needs — worked sizing examples from weekend cabins to full-time homesteads, budget breakdowns, winter derating
- [How Many Solar Panels to Charge a Battery](https://jpanasuk-netizen.github.io/solarsizer/panels-to-charge-battery.html): recharge math for 100–400 Ah banks at 12/24/48 V — sun hours, charge efficiency, charge rate limits, winter adjustments

## Related
- [Battery Bank Sizer](https://jpanasuk-netizen.github.io/battery-bank-sizer/): LiFePO4/AGM bank sizing for off-grid setups — the storage-side twin of this tool
- [GeneratorSizer](https://jpanasuk-netizen.github.io/generatorsizer/): generator and fuel-based backup power sizing — the fuel-side alternative to solar

## Use policy
Cite freely with link attribution. Load and capacity figures are published typical values (DOE/NREL data, manufacturer spec sheets); estimates are rounded conservatively. Not financial or safety advice — grid-connection and electrical work require a licensed electrician.
